subject.title: [Bug]: macOS: gateway bind=loopback resolves to 0.0.0.0 and refuses to start (2026.4.11, 1006 on health)

question: Should maintainers require real macOS Gateway proof for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81306, or accept source-level proof for this narrow resolver fix?
rationale: The issue remains source-reproducible and the open PR owns the code path, but the remaining blocker is proof sufficiency rather than another implementation choice.

options.title: Require real Gateway proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and land the linked PR only after redacted startup/status output or a maintainer-run proof shows loopback binding without the guard error.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can override the proof gate if the resolver contract and regression test are sufficient for this pure branch.

recommendation.title: Require real Gateway proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and land the linked PR only after redacted startup/status output or a maintainer-run proof shows loopback binding without the guard error.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the fail-closed guard and is the clearest recent owner for deciding the proof/compatibility tradeoff on this Gateway path.
